'''Ber de Val''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Ber de Val system/Legends|Ber de Val system]] within the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region.<ref name="Atlas" /> It is home to a non-sentient species of hyperactive rodents.
